id.description: Stable source id. Owns every resource this source imports.

path.description: Absolute path of the package root. Read only; mount it read-only.

onConflict.description: `noop` keeps UI/API edits and skips resources this source does not own. `overwrite` makes the files win and adopts same-named resources.

title: Agent Swarm import sources
description: Value of SWARM_IMPORT_SOURCES (JSON) or the file SWARM_IMPORT_SOURCES_FILE names.
